uvot.scope: Observed UVW2 image and exposure coverage. Photometric sensitivity remains unmeasured.

scope: Pointing cones describe archive metadata. Image and event coverage are verified only for the sampled August 2024 visit. XRT count-rate bounds retain gross aperture counts and use the aperture-mean exposure. No PSF, energy-response or spectral flux conversion is applied. The count-rate limits constrain the Swift snapshot time only.
